translation:
Newborn Infants
For a newborn whose shoulder is contracted inward: take borax (硼砂) and evodia (吳茱萸), five qian each, grind into powder, and apply to the affected area using a large amount.

For a newborn: take a small amount of chicken egg and milk, apply to the chest area, then use cinnabar (朱砂), burnt incense, and a small portion each, fumigate gently — this is an excellent method.

For a newborn whose entire body breaks out in toxic eruptions, which is red cinnabar toxin (丹毒): it is appropriate to use thin tweezers to insert into the points, or if it appears on the abdomen and kidneys, it must be treated.

For crude saltpeter (硝): where red pustules appear with prickling pain all over, also a form of toxic eruption — use thin tweezers, apply the juice, smear the red areas.

Another method: grind red beans with water into a paste, mix with egg white, apply and smear on affected areas.

Another method: burn borax until red, grind finely, mix into a paste, apply and smear on affected areas.

Single Remedies
Cinnabar (朱砂): First formula — treats postpartum conditions. Second formula — treats fourfold postpartum condition, stimulates blood circulation, enters the heart, nourishes the spirit, combines seven [ingredients] — upon seeing [the symptom], use one to two qian of cinnabar dissolved in breast milk.

Heavy basin [alum], eight [qian] — treats postpartum conditions, taken warm with good wine and mixed with breast milk, three doses; can be roasted red and taken dissolved in wine.

Large axe-head iron — treats postpartum blood stagnation and pain; roast red, quench in wine, drink the wine.

Hearth earth (伏龍肝) — use one to two qian, mix and administer; the child should wear it on the head.

甚妙。難產三日不下，伏硝細末，酒下，即下。硝細研，可半兩。

朴硝　龍膽治肝，便死，調服不一，即下，救烙硝細研，明可半兩。

石燕子　主治難產，手把各種，一孕衣立臨產兩，韓肥乾服即死，三取生，次生地黃。

生地黃　葉取即治一姐娘，酒把五漏合血煮不，止三百病能行血，和酒服養之血，揉。

瓮爲　取印取盆葉母，揭草也主産，前煮后百器産，蒸成后，生汁而不小，蒿茉和酒量。

一治，合難，溫産，行死，胎不，天下，行衣不，息下，或以擭，生取，而一不小，蒿茉和酒。

手一活中有血，補行也，故日補，陰之功，前無命，名蓋后，母生，以其虛，以心。

蒲黃治産後調出血，湯後如太多繁蒸發，井泔滞，水調下，韓二，和三錢，之水煎。

當歸治婦名人百病，又治疾，産後腹痛，用當歸，乃末三錢，和血之水煎。

若仁紅花積刺痛頭，服名獨聖湯宜用桃。血刺痛後腹痛，用當歸，乃和血之藥煎。
translation:
Extremely effective. For difficult labor lasting three days without delivery, take finely ground Mirabilite (Piao Xiao) powder with wine, and delivery will occur immediately. Grind the Mirabilite finely; use approximately half a liang.

Mirabilite (Piao Xiao): Treats the liver and prevents death; adjust the dosage and take it, and delivery will occur immediately. Grind finely, approximately half a liang.

Swallow Stone (Shi Yan Zi): Primarily treats difficult labor. Hold it in the hand during various stages of pregnancy; it promotes the expulsion of the placenta at the time of delivery. Take raw Rehmannia (Di Huang) as a follow-up.

Raw Rehmannia (Sheng Di Huang): Treats various conditions; use the juice with wine for flooding and bleeding; boil and stop the bleeding; it promotes blood circulation; take mixed with wine to nourish the blood and press.

Earthen Jar Method (Weng Wei): Take the leaf decoction in a basin, use as the main treatment for difficult labor; boil and steam repeatedly after delivery; take the fresh juice, and use small amounts of Artemisia and Jasmine mixed with wine.

One treatment for difficult labor: warm the uterus to promote labor, if the fetus does not descend, take it orally, if membranes do not expel naturally, rest; use catch and capture methods, take fresh juice, use small amounts of Artemisia and Jasmine mixed with wine.

Activate the middle, replenish blood and qi; this is called tonifying Yin; use before delivery without fail, named for its function of nourishing after delivery and tonifying deficiency at the root.

Pollen of Cattail (Pu Huang): Treats postpartum bleeding; in decoction, reduces excessive bleeding; clear rice water settles it; mix two to three qian and decoct in water.

Chinese Angelica Root (Dang Gui): Treats one hundred diseases in women; also treats illness; for postpartum abdominal pain, use Dang Gui three qian ground to powder, decocted in water to harmonize the blood.

Peach Kernel (Tao Ren) and Safflower (Hong Hua): For stabbing abdominal pain, take the Holy Alone Decoction with peach kernel. For stabbing pain and postpartum abdominal pain, use Dang Gui decocted in water as a blood-harmonizing medicine.

text:
芍藥
主婦人諸疾并產前後諸病癥瘕。酒水煎服對病。又治崩漏生胎動汁。又治交勒至半服之。

艾葉
又使婦人虛腹痛。安胎。有白蜜各能安兩煎止至半服之。

黃芩
不安或以酒煮下血服。亦止交勒也。黃芩安胎藥也。俗人安胎以能養血令血溫循。宜清熱凝實者用之。

紅花
二主盛產後血一盞口分紫閉。服立紅花或兒一兩酒。

玄胡索
末主酒產後至一血盞立及二兩服絕立玄胡索或兒枳心各欲絕為。

桂心
略治汗知九樱桃痛大閥歡欲滄磨下二九為狗。當歸便一或兩熟為調末每二癥瘕下絕桂心為末夠。
translation:
Peony (Shao Yao)
It is the primary herb for all women's ailments, including disorders before and after childbirth and conditions such as abdominal masses. Decoct with wine or water and take according to the condition. Also treats uterine bleeding and fetal restlessness. Also treats contractions; take half a dose.

Mugwort Leaf (Ai Ye)
Also used when a woman has deficiency abdominal pain. Calms the fetus. Combined with white honey, each is able to calm; decoct both and reduce to half dose and take.

Scutellaria (Huang Qin)
For fetal restlessness, or decoct with wine to stop bleeding. Also stops contractions. Scutellaria is a fetal-calming herb. Common people use it to calm the fetus because it can nourish the blood and warm the blood's circulation. It is appropriate for those with heat accumulation to use.

Safflower (Hong Hua)
Primarily used after childbirth for blood stasis; take one cup, divided doses, to open obstruction. Take standing dose of one to two liang of safflower in wine.

Corydalis (Xuan Hu Suo)
Powder the herb; after childbirth decoct with wine, one cup; take standing dose, combined with one to two liang; take to exhaustion; or combine with bitter orange and cinnamon heart, each taken until collapse.

Cinnamon Heart (Gui Xin)
Used for sweating, cherry-like pain, abdominal masses, extreme thirst, and grinding pain below; take nine pills for dogs [illegible]. Combine with Angelica root, one or two liang, cooked, adjusted, powdered, taken every two doses for abdominal masses below; use cinnamon heart powdered sufficiently.

translation:
Mulberry Mistletoe (Sang Jisaeng)
Treats persistent uterine bleeding during pregnancy, or when post-delivery blood stasis is severe and not resolved by other medicines; stabilizes the fetus; also treats blood pain and lochia; decoct and take as powder with water.

Sappanwood (Su Mok)
Treats near-death conditions after delivery; take one liang, shave and decoct in wine and water, take as a final powder.

Mantis Egg Case (Sang Pyoso)
For each mother: two pieces; treats urinary difficulties, pain, inability to drink, and irregular [conditions]; used as a final powder.

Carp Scales (Yi Eo Rin)
Grind and treat; dissolves postpartum [blood stasis]; one qian; able to break up stagnation; adjust with Korean powder.

Cuttlefish Flesh (O Jeok Eo Yuk)
Treats pain; governs blood conditions; completely stops [bleeding]; relieves palpitations; dissolves blood stasis in the abdomen; in severe cases this is called "killing-blood" in the heart and abdomen.

Mussel (Dam Chae)
Take dried [mussels] and stir-fry to powder; mix with vinegar soup to treat pain below the heart.

Snake Slough (Sa Tae)
Treats abscesses and blood-qi disorders after delivery; can be decocted or dried; also for cases of accumulated blood clots; when fully dried, one coin-sized piece; apply the remaining [preparation] to the hands.

Lotus Juice (U Jeup)
After delivery, when blood rushes upward to the heart causing pain, drink two sheng of fresh lotus root juice.
After delivery, all raw foods are forbidden except lotus root, because it has the ability to break up blood stagnation.

translation:
Citrus Peel (Gamjapi)
It mainly treats postpartum edema. Decoct the peel in wine and drink. As Lei Gong says, finely [process it]...

Grape Root (Podogeunn)
It mainly treats postpartum edema in women. Decoct the peel in wine and drink. Make a concentrated decoction...

Peach Kernel (Doin)
[Grind to] fine powder, boil in hot water, clarify, and at the appropriate time take half a dou. Grind finely and apply. Also mix with wheat and take with lye water. [Used for] double-kernel peaches, which are also called "sealed peach."

Sesame Oil (Hama-yu)
Facilitates easy delivery and expels the fetus. Take the pressed black sesame oil, drink it. It is the chief [remedy] for expelling the afterbirth. If water does not [work]...

Hemp Root (Daema-geun)
For women who do not conceive or for monthly [irregularities]. It is calculated for assisting the womb and placenta. Take the root, make a concentrated decoction, drink frequently. [Can] terminate [fertility]...

Black Soybean (Heukdu)
For women who do not conceive or for monthly [irregularities]. Take black soybeans, grind to powder, add vinegar, extract the liquid, take a dose. [Can] terminate [fertility]...

Fermented Leaven (Singyuk / Shen Qu)
It can cause the fetus to descend and expel. Take the juice, take two qian (coins' weight) in a dose, and the fetus will immediately descend.

Barley Malt (Daemaengnyak)
If a pregnant woman has illness and wishes to terminate the pregnancy, take malt and the fetus will immediately descend.

translation:
Vinegar: Treats cases where the fetus has died in the womb and cannot be delivered. Boil three cups of vinegar with black beans, take the resulting liquid and drink it, and the fetus will immediately be expelled. Grind the residue into powder, mix with water and drink; it will work immediately.

Mallow Seeds (Donggyuja): Indicated for difficult labor and fetal restlessness causing instability. Also used for difficult childbirth. Take a pinch of the seeds, grind into powder, mix with water and drink.

Scallion White (Green onion): Indicated for fetal restlessness and instability, with bleeding downward and abdominal pain. Boil and take the liquid. Pound to extract the juice; take two portions.

Purslane (Machi Hyeon): Indicated for postpartum fever with blood clots and abdominal pain. Pound to extract the juice and drink it.

Stork Double Leaf: Take child's urine, blend and adjust; take one dose of powdered form, mix well and swallow; take three times daily. [Partial text, partly illegible]

Chicken Egg: Removes retained placenta that cannot be expelled; immediately promotes delivery. Three branches of [herb], powdered and blended; take three times daily. [Partial text]

Deer Antler Gelatin: Used internally for difficult labor. Mix two liang of gelatin with one and a half cups of good wine; heat gently over a low flame until dissolved.

Donkey-hide Gelatin (Agyo): Used internally for difficult labor. Shave fine filings, two liang, with warm good wine, one cup; promotes immediate delivery.

Deer Antler: With scallion white, lettuce, and other ingredients combined, boil and drink the decoction; the fetus will be immediately expelled.

translation:
Rabbit's Head Bone
Primarily used to induce labor, expel the placenta, and treat postpartum retention of bad blood. Take one rabbit's head bone, burn it to ash, grind into powder, and take one qian with wine. Stir-fry each ingredient accordingly to induce delivery.

Cat's Head Bone
Primarily used to treat difficult labor. Roast thoroughly, grind into powder, burn to ash. Take two qian of Cnidium and Angelica decoction in water, mixed with one qian of the bone powder, stir-fry accordingly to induce delivery.

Sheep Kidney
Harmonizes and treats postpartum deficiency and weakness, lack of strength, and general debility. Take one pair of sheep kidneys, roast and slice finely, make into a thin gruel with five spices; good for bone and joint pain, or cook in a pot as a good food. Also finely slice pig kidney and make into thin gruel to eat; for difficult labor, dress with oil and steam.

Pig Kidney
Adjust with water, divide portions, and immediately [give to the patient]. Cook eight chestnuts with the bone, make into otter-food [gruel] and eat to relieve difficult labor.

Musk
Easily treats and collects [the fetus], and also induces labor and causes descent of the fetus. Take one qian dissolved in water and drink to induce delivery.

Elm Bark (White Bark)
Easily induces delivery, greatly raises and expels the fetus, causing immediate death and expulsion. In cases where a person is ill and wishes to remove the fetus, take the bark powder and boil the white bark into a decoction. Take one qian twice daily.

Sweet Bamboo Root
Easily treats restless fetal movement. Boil sweet bamboo root into a decoction and drink. [Also applicable with] Korean bamboo.

translation:
Xuegen (Madder Root): Two treatments for pregnant women. Removes and dislodges the fetus. For cases where the woman desires to abort, treats abdominal pain that is unbearable. A wondrous remedy — do not take it lightly.

Qu Mai (Fringed Pink/Dianthus): Take internally to break up and expel the fetus. Stir-fry. Treats difficult labor and death of the fetus. Treats difficult delivery.

Che Qian Zi (Plantain Seeds): Treats difficult labor and failure to deliver. The juice does not come out. This is the method.

Shui Yin (Mercury): Take two liang, look into the middle of it, and the child will come out. For retained placenta that will not descend, with the fetus dead in the womb and large masses forming.

Da Huang (Rhubarb Root): Treats difficult labor, transverse presentation, failure to collect, and cutting off of the umbilical cord. Treats difficult labor and recurrent difficult deliveries.

Acupuncture and Moxibustion Methods:
For male patients: apply moxibustion at Gall Bladder point, five cones of moxa. There is no need for needling — the Korean tradition says it is sufficient. For filling and blocking the conception vessel, apply moxa at the Gate of Life point, left and right sides. Also apply moxa at the Zi Hu (Child's Door) point. Moxibustion at the Gate of the Origin point, right side, three days of moxibustion, thirty cones, to the count of two. Or needle the border of the Gate of Origin. Seven cones, or needle — immediately induces labor.

For difficult labor: Yin Jiao, Shi Men, expels dead fetus. Take Da Chong, Fu He, Gu, San Yin Jiao, Qiu Xu, San Lian, Jia Yi — from the Jia Yi Jing.

For retained lochia (after delivery, the malignant blood not yet expelled): half a sheng, cook together into a paste, form pills the size of wutong seeds, take with water.

translation:
Dongui Bogam, Miscellaneous Diseases, Volume 10

[Section on difficult labor and retained placenta, acupuncture methods:]

At the time of labor, to relieve difficulty: needle the point Juque (巨闕) six fen deep, retaining the needle for seven breaths, to obtain qi. This helps the birth proceed correctly and regulates the person.

For the method of using needles on the mother's eye point: insert the needle into the center of the palm to reach Juque, retaining for seven breaths to obtain qi. If there are needle marks toward the point of birth, the child's bones will descend, and the spirit-qi will immediately cause the ghost-influences to cease.

For cases where the placenta is retained after delivery, or for difficult labor: take the points on the right leg, named in the Bogam — needle to the small alarm point, take the upper needle, cutting off the worm influence, for the spirit-shen.

For three instances of non-delivery, immediately after delivery, for swelling, for three li [points], take water and various medicines combined.

For retained placenta after birth, for swelling below, three li points.

[Supplementary instructions:] These are the acupoints: press and record; after [needling], by oneself there will be movement of the pulse responding under the fingers. Place transversely, calm the heart, keep straight — all instruct the woman afterward to take [the treatment]. Seven moxa cones at both ends to exhaustion.

Fix, mark, hands and feet, to measure by listening — heart, one, illuminating the sea, Shenjue (神闕), Yuanyin point — take the placenta-clothing after birth, three measures.
These points: press and record afterward, self-movement of the pulse responds under the fingers transversely — calm the heart, keep straight — all instruct the woman afterward to take [the treatment], reclining, mouth open.
